html:
SMTO-UI-0026 — You can't add files while updating a running task

GUID: 551e5fbb-0281-4fa3-b97b-9e2de94f4923
Slug: ui-resources-locked
Domain: UI · Subsystem: ui

What happened

  • You're sending an update to a task that is already running, so SMTO has turned off adding files and saved context. Nothing you already sent was changed.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. To give the running task a file or saved item with your update, type @ in the message box and pick it from the list, then send your update. While you update a running task, @ is the way to add items to it; the Add context button is turned off.
  2. If the files are for new work instead, leave update mode: select the × at the end of the update bar above the message box, or press Esc. The Add context button stays off until the update bar is gone.
  3. Once the bar is gone, select Add context next to the message box and choose your files or saved context for your next message. A new message starts new work, and new work can include new files.

What success looks like

  • The Add context button works again and your files appear under the message box.

If it still fails

  • If Add context stays greyed out after the update bar is gone, select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't keep clicking attach while updating; it is blocked on purpose.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The composer's attachment controls are locked because steering mode is active (a steer request is selected), so assertCanAttach() refuses new uploads or linked Context for the running task.

What this means

  • Attachment controls find resourcesLocked during the current steering flow. The shown control rejects this local action before its dependent submission. Earlier requests and saved state are unaffected by this validation result; server-side authority remains authoritative.

Why this can happen

  • Attachment controls find resourcesLocked during the current steering flow.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect steering/resource-lock state before changing context for new work.

How to fix it

  • native_controls.js assertCanAttach() throws ui_resources_locked while hooks.isSteering() is true (state.steerRequestId set), so the Add context button, file picker and Context/artifact linking are disabled. Exit steering with #exit-steer or Escape, or let the steering submission finish; to give the running task extra resources, select them with @ in the steering composer (input_resources.js), otherwise attach them to a new prompt.
  • Finish or leave the current steering flow before changing context resources for new work.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • New context is selected in an eligible composer flow after leaving the active steering operation.

What not to do

  • Do not use a rapid retry loop or replay an uncertain mutation while waiting for the stated condition.

Technical notes

  • The shown control rejects this local action before its dependent submission. Earlier requests and saved state are unaffected by this validation result; server-side authority remains authoritative.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
